_about: Jurisdictions built from OpenStreetMap administrative boundaries by tools/fetch_osm_jurisdictions.py. The boundaries are real; which body answers a pollution alert inside each is an explicit policy table in that script, and a deployment must confirm it with the bodies named before sending real alerts.
_licence: Boundary data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0. https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
_coordinate_order: [longitude, latitude], WGS84, matching GeoJSON and PostGIS
_escalation_tier: The district administration (tier 1) is notified before the state pollution control body (tier 2), so both are not alerted for one event, each assuming the other is handling it.
_contact: Addresses are on the reserved .invalid domain. No real inbox is contacted by a seeded deployment.
